prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after pet/companion selection, wait time countdowns, pet control tutorial screens, personality headlines, and specific hints (path duration, account sync, pet persistence) consistently won.
Major redesigns, trait selector flows, photo guidance, benefits story copy, path time headlines, account recovery hints, and moving sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Notifications, layout modifications, incentives, permission checks, and wait screen activity tips showed no clear effect.
Flow bypasses yielded mixed results, winning in round 1 but hurting performance in round 3.
Predictions overestimated gains for major redesigns, trait selector flows, late sign-in reordering, and copy changes.
Predictions underestimated gains for pet control tutorial screens, wait countdowns, personality headlines, path duration hints, and account safety/persistence hints.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account pet sync reassurance note on sign in: Displays a clear account synchronization hint below sign-in options clarifying that signing in restores and preserves existing desktop pets. (why: Support receives 8 complaints about pets missing or resetting after signing in again, making post-sign-in persistence assurance crucial.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Companion selection grid layout redesign: Redesigns the friend picking screen into a grid layout showcasing pet personalities and visual previews clearly. (why: Adoption has a heavy drop-off (69.3% conversion, 89s median) indicating decision friction when selecting companion pets.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop controls onboarding sub-flow: Adds a interactive checklist component on the home intro screen guiding users through hiding, showing, and chatting with their pet. (why: Multiple support tickets report confusion post-onboarding regarding pet controls and visibility on the desktop.)
3: [choose_path, hint] Companion selection duration hint: Adds a duration hint to path selection screen letting users know path setup takes less than 1 minute. (why: Lessons highlight that path duration hints consistently boost initial onboarding funnel progress.)
4: [adoption, redesign] Adoption certificate milestone stage redesign: Redesigns the adoption certificate step into a spotlight layout highlighting the official pet adoption name and badge. (why: The adoption stage drops from 83.8% to 69.3% conversion, requiring a stronger visual confirmation of adoption.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo companion compatibility guidance hint: Adds a clear hint on photo upload detailing quick photo requirements to prevent generation glitches. (why: Support logged 3 issues where custom pet generation failed or pet appearance looked wrong.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop companion activation progress ticker: Adds an estimated activation time countdown and live progress component to the waiting screen. (why: Home initialization median duration is high (201s); explicit wait progress timer components keep users engaged.)

scores.note: Account sync and persistence hints consistently won in previous tests and directly address 8 support complaints.
Target step has high drop-off but major redesigns consistently hurt performance and require release code.
Pet control tutorial screens consistently won and directly resolve multiple support issues regarding controls.
Path duration hints consistently boost conversion and require zero code release.
Redesigns of stages consistently underperform despite the high drop-off at the adoption step.
Lessons show photo guidance specifically hurt performance despite addressing support tickets.
Wait time countdowns consistently won and address long wait time median on home initial step.
